study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial
exposure: Timing of maternal discharge after cesarean delivery (POD 2, POD 3, POD ≥4)
cohort: 1391 women who underwent uncomplicated but unscheduled cesarean delivery.
finding: The risk of the composite outcome of maternal readmission, unscheduled clinic visit, or ER visit was higher in women discharged on postoperative day (POD) 3 or later compared to those discharged on POD 2.
